mapper.select: SELECT a.apply_id, a.apply_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.apply_status, a.applicant_name, r.room_id, r.room_name, r.capacity, r.room_status, r.manager_id, t.teacher_id, t.name as teacher_name, t.dept as teacher_dept FROM ROOM_APPLY a LEFT JOIN MEETING_ROOM r ON a.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON a.teacher_id = t.teacher_id ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC

SELECT a.apply_id, a.apply_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.apply_status, a.applicant_name, r.room_id, r.room_name, r.capacity, r.room_status, r.manager_id, t.teacher_id, t.name as teacher_name, t.dept as teacher_dept FROM ROOM_APPLY a LEFT JOIN MEETING_ROOM r ON a.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON a.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE a.apply_id = #{applyId}

SELECT a.apply_id, a.apply_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.apply_status, a.applicant_name, r.room_id, r.room_name, r.capacity, r.room_status, r.manager_id, t.teacher_id, t.name as teacher_name, t.dept as teacher_dept FROM ROOM_APPLY a LEFT JOIN MEETING_ROOM r ON a.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON a.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE a.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC

SELECT a.apply_id, a.apply_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.apply_status, a.applicant_name, r.room_id, r.room_name, r.capacity, r.room_status, r.manager_id, t.teacher_id, t.name as teacher_name, t.dept as teacher_dept FROM ROOM_APPLY a LEFT JOIN MEETING_ROOM r ON a.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON a.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE a.apply_status = #{status} ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC

SELECT a.apply_id, a.apply_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.apply_status, r.room_id, r.room_name, r.capacity, r.room_status, t.teacher_id, t.name as teacher_name FROM ROOM_APPLY a LEFT JOIN MEETING_ROOM r ON a.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON a.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE a.room_id = #{roomId} AND DATE(a.start_time) = #{date} AND a.apply_status IN (0, 1) AND ( (TIME(a.start_time) < #{endTime} AND TIME(a.end_time) > #{startTime}) )
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM_APPLY SET room_id = #{room.roomId}, teacher_id = #{teacher.teacherId}, applicant_name = #{applicantName}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, apply_status = #{applyStatus} WHERE apply_id = #{applyId}
